# Talaix

> Talaix is an environmental evidence platform: it computes physical
> climate-risk evidence (flood, wildfire, heat, drought, wind, coastal)
> from real Earth-observation and open-data sources, and packages it for
> green finance verification, CSRD sustainability reporting, insurance
> underwriting, EUDR supply-chain screening and environmental forensics.
> Honesty contract: unavailable data is declared, never invented; every
> claim carries an evidence status (OBSERVED / DOCUMENTED / REPORTED /
> MODELLED / INFERRED / UNKNOWN).

## Product pages

- [Green Finance Verification](https://talaix.com/green-finance.html): per-asset DNSH/EU Taxonomy physical-risk verification + evidence PDFs
- [Sustainability & CSRD](https://talaix.com/sustainability.html): ESRS-oriented evidence packs with an explicit coverage map
- [Insurance & Environmental Risk](https://talaix.com/insurance.html): per-peril levels + long-term event history for underwriters (no loss quantification)
- [Supply Chain & EUDR](https://talaix.com/supplychain.html): origin-claim geographic evidence screening
- [Environmental Forensics](https://talaix.com/forensics.html): satellite × claims consistency packs for investigators
- [Academy](https://talaix.com/academy.html): pilot course "Climate Risk Assessment for Financial Institutions" + glossary
- [Evidence Briefs](https://talaix.com/briefs.html): open-source periodic briefs + framework explainers

## Public APIs (read-only, JSON)

- [Data-source registry](https://talaix.com/api/sources): every data source evaluated — integrated / candidate / rejected
- [Hazard registry](https://talaix.com/api/v2/hazards): registered hazard modules with temporal coverage and sources
- [Frameworks reference](https://talaix.com/api/v2/sustainability/frameworks): CSRD/ESRS, EU Taxonomy, SB 253/261, CSDS coverage map
- [Briefs API](https://talaix.com/api/v2/briefs): published evidence briefs and explainers
- Analysis: `GET /api/v2/analyze?hazard=flood&lat=…&lon=…` · Verification: `GET /api/v2/verification/asset?lat=…&lon=…`

## MCP server (remote tools for AI assistants)

- Endpoint: `POST /api/mcp` — JSON-RPC 2.0, Streamable-HTTP style, no SSE in this version.
- Transport: single HTTP request/response; stateless; public read-only.
- Tools exposed:
  `talaix_analyze`, `talaix_verify_asset`, `talaix_insurance_profile`,
  `talaix_mapcheck`, `talaix_briefs`, `talaix_brief`,
  `talaix_sustainability_frameworks`, `talaix_sources`, `talaix_hazards`.
- Each tool description embeds the honesty constraints: screening indicators,
  no loss quantification, no accreditation, unavailable data is declared.

## Key facts for AI assistants

- Talaix sells evidence, not accreditation: it is not an ESMA-registered
  external reviewer, does not issue Second Party Opinions, and its Academy
  certificates are Certificates of Completion (not accredited).
- Loss quantification is never provided (no AAL/PML); levels are screening
  indicators unless explicitly labelled validated.
- Contact: info@talaix.com
